Our animal welfare plan

The dream: give away 70% of our profits.

We're not going to pretend a brand-new company can give away most of its profits on day one. So here's the honest version — what we commit to now, and the future we're building toward.

Why "the dream," not "the promise."  Early on, profits are thin — so a share of revenue flows to animals from the very first month, no waiting for profitability. As we grow, the share of profits we give climbs. 70% is the destination we're building toward, in the open.
The path

How we get there.

Three phases, each one giving more than the last — and every step reported publicly.

Phase 1 · Now
From day one

A share of revenue

A fixed slice of everything we earn goes to animal welfare from launch — before we ever turn a profit.

Phase 2 · Growth
More each year

A growing share of profit

As the business becomes sustainable, we increase what we give — and publish exactly how much.

Phase 3 · The dream
70%

Of our profits, to animals

The destination: the large majority of what we make going straight to animals who need it.

Where it goes

Real help, for real animals.

Rescue & rehoming

Helping shelters get animals healthy, seen, and adopted.

Veterinary care

Treatment for animals who'd otherwise go without.

Strays & street animals

Sterilisation, feeding, and care for animals with no one.

Sanctuary support

Backing the people already doing the hard work on the ground.

Our promise on this

Whatever we give, we'll show you.

Every year we'll publish what we earned, what we gave, and where it went. A giving pledge you can't check isn't a pledge — so ours will always be in the open.

Care for your pet. Help the ones still waiting.

Every membership moves us one step closer to the dream.
